name: Nguyễn Đình Chiểu tomb and memorial
nameVi: Lăng và đền thờ Nguyễn Đình Chiểu
kicker: Tomb and memorial of the poet at Ba Tri
summary: Poet's tomb at Ba Tri: walk the memorial garden on a morning, on 1 July or any day, for the national relic. The ground has been a national historic relic since 27 April 1990. The culture days run 30 June–2 July, and the day itself is 1 July on the solar calendar. Come on that day or on an ordinary morning.
getThere: 2 km from the center of thị trấn Ba Tri, on tỉnh lộ 885.
heroCaption: The tomb of the poet and his wife, with the hall behind

notice.title: 1 July is a solar date
notice.body: The culture days run 30 June–2 July. On an ordinary day the garden is still the visit.

body: The tomb and memorial sit in old xã An Đức, 2 km from the center of thị trấn Ba Tri, on tỉnh lộ 885 through Giồng Trôm. The ground is now in xã Ba Tri. The tomb stayed where it was. It has been a national historic relic since 27 April 1990, on 13,000 m².

Nguyễn Đình Chiểu was born on 1 July 1822. He lived and worked here. The culture days run 30 June–2 July, and the day itself is 1 July on the solar calendar. The program includes đờn ca tài tử, a costume play of Lục Vân Tiên and Kiều Nguyệt Nga, recited verse, drum, traditional martial arts, a feast, and yard games.

figures.caption: The memorial hall at Ba Tri, with the court in front
figures.alt: The memorial hall of Nguyễn Đình Chiểu at Ba Tri, roof and court

gettingThere: The ground is 2 km from the center of thị trấn Ba Tri, on tỉnh lộ 885 through Giồng Trôm. That 2 km is the last stretch at Ba Tri. Minutes from Ben Tre town are a question for the driver.

legs.heading: From Ben Tre
legs.body: By road on tỉnh lộ 885 through Giồng Trôm, then 2 km from the center of thị trấn Ba Tri. Minutes from the town are a question for the driver.

closed: No weekly closing day is posted. The culture days run 30 June–2 July, and the day is 1 July solar.
admissionNote: No ticket is posted. The national historic-relic date is 27 April 1990.
